visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide handheld shot from the stands of the Fukuoka PayPay Dome, showing a dense crowd of spectators watching a baseball game under bright stadium lighting. (2) A woman in a black shirt holds a long yellow balloon, laughing and cheering as the camera pans slightly to show the massive interior structure of the dome. (3) The scene shifts to an exterior view of the Mizuho PayPay Dome under a clear blue sky, followed by a screen recording of the Klook app showing baseball ticket options. (4) A hand holds three printed tickets in front of a yellow service counter marked '5'. (5) A subway map and signage for the 'SoftBank HAWKS' are shown inside a station, followed by a street-level shot of people walking toward the stadium. (6) Back inside, the wide interior of the dome is captured, showing the green artificial turf and a giant scoreboard displaying player stats. (7) Close-up shots show a middle-aged man wearing glasses eating katsu curry and drinking beer from a cup branded with the SoftBank Hawks logo. (8) Highlights on the giant screen show players sliding into bases during the game. (9) A montage of the stadium's food court and fans blowing up yellow balloons follows. (10) The camera captures hundreds of fans simultaneously releasing yellow balloons into the air, creating a vibrant scene. (11) The final shots show the narrator's parents walking outside near the stadium and more views of the cheering crowd inside.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 帶長輩去看日職他們會喜歡嗎. (2) [Subtitle]: 前陣子1打2帶我爸媽去福岡四天三夜. (3) [Logo]: MIZUHO PayPay Dome. (4) [Subtitle]: 順便解鎖軟銀的福岡巨蛋. (5) [Slogan]: 於是在Klook上買了最便宜的預留A席. (6) [Slogan]: 一張票台幣$867. (7) [Logo]: SoftBank HAWKS. (8) [Subtitle]: 從福岡市區到巨蛋很方便. (9) [Subtitle]: 地鐵出站跟著人群走連Google都不用. (10) [Subtitle]: 位置是坐在內野的3壘側視野很不錯. (11) [Subtitle]: 旁邊還剛好遇到一樣來看球的台灣人. (12) [Subtitle]: 雖然我爸媽平常完全沒在看棒球. (13) [Subtitle]: 屬於國際賽才會關注一下的中華隊球迷. (14) [Subtitle]: 但對於日職初體驗很滿意. (15) [Subtitle]: 過程中不斷讚嘆福岡巨蛋很舒服螢幕超大冷氣很涼. (16) [Subtitle]: 食物選項也非常多. (17) [Subtitle]: 我媽最喜歡的是山川穗高的出場動畫. (18) [Logo]: YAMAKAWA HOTAKA. (19) [Variety]: BOSUKOI. (20) [Subtitle]: 每次他要上場打擊前都會說那個拿著金箍棒的孫悟空要來了. (21) [Subtitle]: 我還去買了氣球讓兩老體驗一下福岡巨蛋特有的活動. (22) [Subtitle]: 結果被說浪費錢. (23) [Subtitle]: 整體來說他們對於福岡巨蛋的初體驗很滿意. (24) [Subtitle]: 我覺得應該是有冷氣的關係啦. (25) [Subtitle]: 不然現在夏天去室外球場可能看3局就想回家了.
